children.name: Helper
children.content: Name of a load-balancer address pool configured by your cluster admin, plus an optional specific address to request. Applies only when Expose is set to LoadBalancer — ignored otherwise.

JmFhb.content: Expose is set to NodePort. Address pool and requested address only take effect when Expose (above) is set to LoadBalancer.
This cluster has no MetalLB or Cilium address manager. Your pool and address preference will be saved but never applied.
